payload.blocks: Landing phase 6 (orphan rotation, doctor pointer, Stop-hook fix). Its decoder fix runs now; phases 2, 4, 7 unaffected.
payload.headline: Widen the heads-stable footprint by three files so phase 6 can register its doctor row and surface hook failures?

parts.cause: The footprint names the doctor registry and wiring but not the two inventories that pin the row set, nor the Rust hook entry, which the phase file said might need widening.

options.does: add the three paths to the plan footprint; phase 6 updates the count, the inventory and the hook's failure incident
options.gain: phase 6 lands complete with npm test green; failing Stops become visible
options.label: Widen by all three files

options.does: register the doctor row; leave hook-entry visibility for a later item
options.harm: a Stop that fails before the Node entry stays invisible
options.label: Widen by the two inventories only

parts.recommendation: Widen by all three files: test/setup/registrations.test.mjs, docs/platform/packaging-distribution/contracts/setup-doctor-registry.md, apps/fgos/src/wiring/session_rotation_hook.rs.

scope.allows: Adding exactly those three paths to the plan footprint.

parts.what: Phase 6 found why real Stops never rotate: the head-request decoder (head_request.rs, in footprint) turns a decimal fraction into a serde private number map, so every Stop is refused bad-measure (this lead's supervisor.log, 03:32Z, 03:57Z); that fix runs now. Landing also needs three files outside the footprint: test/setup/registrations.test.mjs (doctor row count 103 to 104), setup-doctor-registry.md (inventory gains session-rotation-orphans), session_rotation_hook.rs (a pre-Node hook failure prints only stderr).
